turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What can I do for you?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So I've been, just over the last week, I've been feeling pretty sick. I have this pretty bad headache that started like probably a week ago, and then for the last few days I've been having these chills. Um, and I didn't get a chance to measure my temperature at all, um, but the worst thing has been just these muscle aches all over my body, and that's been going on for the last three to four days.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Sorry to hear that you're feeling so, uh, horrible over the past week. Um let's uh, let's try to understand this a little bit better. So you've had this headache for the past week or so. Where exactly is it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It's kind of just uh, all across my forehead. It's been going to the sides, like into my temples as well.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and what does it feel like? How would you describe it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh yeah, it feels like, kind of like uh aching um, I, I have had headaches with throbbing before, but it's not so much throbbing it's more just constant, aching pain.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um, if you had to give it a number from 1 to 10, with 10 being the worst um, pain ever, what number would you give it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, probably like a 7.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Oh wow, yeah, that sounds severe. How long have you, how long has it been a 7 for?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, it's actually a bit better now, but yeah, like over the last week it's been a 7. I would say now, it's probably around 5.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Um, anything that makes the headache better?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um I, I take like Tylenol, then like, it gets relieved for a bit, for like a few hours, and then comes back.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Anything that you feel makes the headaches worse? Any postures, or positions, or activity or um, any kind of exposure to light or sounds?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no it's, it's just kind of there. Nothing makes it worse.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you have nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, no nausea or vomiting.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No. Any sensitivity to light or sounds?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Uh, and is it only, is it only on one, on one side of your head or forehead, or is it on both sides?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh it, it seems like it's on both sides.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And have you noticed any visual changes? Any blurry vision with the headaches?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any other visual changes? No, okay. Um, and you've also had chills, but you said you haven't checked your temperature, right?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't, uh, I've been having chills for the last few nights.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, we can definitely check your temperature here in the, um here. Um, and you mentioned that the muscle aches have been quite bothersome for you. Is it all over your body or anyone, uh, in any one muscle group?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It seems like it's all over.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, okay. And um, I'll ask you about a couple other symptoms just to rule out um, any other issues that you might be having. So have you noticed that you've been confused at all over the past few days?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, I don't think so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you had any like stiffness or rigidity in your neck?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Maybe a little bit of a stiffness in, in my neck.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Then like I, I don't know if that's just the muscle pain. It's like kind of on my upper back, lower neck area.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: We can definitely um, examine that, um, when I'm doing physical examine and see how that is. Um, okay, and uh, have you had any, um, redness in your eyes, or any teary eyes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do the headaches come and go, or is it always there?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, they're pretty much like constant throughout the day.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um, and do you have a runny nose or stuffy nose?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, no I don't I, I think I'm kind of, I'm developing a little cough though.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, when did that start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Probably just yesterday I noticed myself coughing.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Is it like a dry cough or wet cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, a dry cough.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any sputum or any blood come out?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any sore throat?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Uh, any chest pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any difficulties with breathing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any palpitations, or feel like your heart's beating very fast?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, any belly pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any uh, nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any uh, diarrhea or constipation?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not that I've noticed.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any weakness in any one side of your body?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any numbness or tingling?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, okay. Um, any exposures uh, to anyone who could be sick?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, I haven't noticed, but I, I do go to work, um, and we recently switched to like in person instead of I, I used to do um, home work, but for the last month I've been going into the office.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see, and have you been wearing a mask?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, well I try to wear the mask. Sometimes like uh, in the, in the stock, like lounge, we like take take off the mask to eat and stuff but that's about it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Are you maintaining social distancing when you're taking your mask off?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, it's uh, most of the times we're pretty socially distanced when we're eating, but sometimes it's like hard to control when you know, when you're going near the microwave to heat up your food, and sometimes it gets hard. It's a, it's a fairly small room, so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, well I would, I would recommend that you try to eat when people are not in the room if possible because you are putting yourself at risk.  Like if it's a small room, I think you should also talk to management or try to limit the number of people who can be in the room at a time. Um, for your own safety, you know, and for the safety of others uh, working with you. Um okay, and um, have you traveled anywhere recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, we've been uh, at home.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, good, um, and who do you live with?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I live with my young, like uh, daughter and then my wife as well.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and you, do you think they might have got any contacts to anyone who is sick?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, they've been completely fine. Uh, my daughter is like, is uh, doing school from home right now, so she's not really seeing anyone.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, that's good. And um, do you currently smoke?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I do, I do smoke um, probably half a pack a day.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: For how long?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, for probably the last 20 years.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and do you uh, consume marijuana?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Just um, maybe once or twice a month.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Just uh, sometimes, it helps me sleep sometimes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Sure. Do you take any recreational drugs like cocaine, amphetamine, LSD, ecstasy, etc.?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I drink probably uh, a beer or two every couple days.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and uh, do you have any medical conditions that you've been diagnosed with?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh yeah, so I do, they're saying I might have um, high blood pressure. Um they like, it, it's still ongoing. Um they're testing, testing me for things.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Sure yeah, and have you uh, taken any medications for it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not yet, I haven't been put on any medications.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you, do you take anything over the counter? Any herbal pills, vitamins, minerals, etc.?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and do you have any allergies?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No allergies.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, good. Um, and have you had any surgeries in the past or any hospitalizations?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um I was pretty young, I had my tonsils removed um, but other than that no no other surgeries or hospitalizations.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Good. Any family history of any medical conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, so I think my mother, she, she has like type 2 diabetes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: And uh, my father has been pretty healthy, like no issues with him.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Good. Um, okay, have you had any um, have you had migraines in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, yeah, sometimes I, when I'm like stressed at work and like I uh, it's not like anything regular that happens to me. I probably have had migraines in the past.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, okay, and have you ever been diagnosed with asthma or um, with uh, COPD?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, alright, um so it sounds like you've had a headache for the past week, which has been kind of constant, about 7 out of 10. And then you've also developed a fever, but you haven't, or I guess you've been feeling, you've been having chills uh, and we can measure temperature here, and you also had a cough that started yesterday. What about um, sense of taste? Have you noticed any changes there?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no, not that I've really noticed.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What about your sense of smell?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, my smell, I don't think so, but like sometimes I do feel a bit, like stuffy as well. Like not, not right now, but before when I felt stuffy I lost my sense of smell.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Sure, yeah, okay. Um, okay well that's all the questions I have for you. We'll do a physical exam um, get a chest x-ray done, also examine your neck as well a little bit, just to make sure there's no stiffness or rigidity, have a look inside your mouth, um, listen to your chest.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Okay.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: We will also get a COVID swab done, simply because your symptoms sound very similar to um, or I guess a lot of these symptoms do overlap with symptoms of COVID, so we'll do that. And um, I would require, would request that you continue to uh, stay at home if you haven't been doing so so far. Um, take a leave from work, try to do work from home, and quarantine at home as much as possible and stay away from your wife and your daughter as well, at least until the swab is back and you get some more guidance from uh, public health. If it is positive, they will give you a call. Um, there are lots of guidelines on how to self isolate and I, I can share that with you. Um, it's best that you do that for now. Um, we will run a couple of tests, do labs, and based on those results, uh, we'll decide if you need to stay in the ER or if we can um, if you can be discharged later today. Do you have any questions for me?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no that, that all sounds great. Thanks for explaining it to me.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: You're welcome.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Okay.
